about_the_game:
"Don't play with me!"

"Silent:Abandoned" is a short horror experience centered around two brothers—Michael and John—who are passionate vloggers exploring abandoned places. What starts as a simple quest for content soon spirals into a dark and unsettling journey.

"Silent:Abandoned" is a psychological horror in the genre of "walking simulator"

Average Time to Complete the Game: 60 Minutes

About the game.

They are two brothers—Michael and John—vloggers who love exploring abandoned places. One night, they decide to visit an infamous abandoned house. No one has ever been able to enter it—not even the most popular vloggers. But that night, something unexpected happens. When they arrive, Michael steps inside and suddenly becomes trapped, while John mysteriously vanishes outside. Now, Michael must find a way to survive. Strange and sinister things begin to unfold within the house, which seems to be taken over by demonic forces.

Play as Michael, the main character, and explore a mysterious, ever-changing house in a slow-paced, atmospheric world. Experience a blend of eerily familiar and horrifyingly realistic environments as you unravel the truth and survive the terror.

Environment

The game takes place inside a desolate, abandoned house shrouded in darkness. You're completely alone… or so it seems. But something feels off. Faint whispers, distant knocks, and unsettling noises echo through the halls—none of them coming from you. Where are they coming from? And why do they feel so close?

As you explore deeper, a strange sensation creeps in—like your mind is slowly unraveling. Reality begins to twist, and the line between what's real and imagined starts to blur.

Key Features

  • "The main genre is 'Walking Simulator.'"

  • You have to take pictures of things to get proof

  •  Bodycam experience

  • Realistic Graphics

  • Rushing means missing—secrets and fragments of the truth lie buried in the silence of each room.

  • You can take pictures to gather evidence of the house;

WARNING:

Epileptic seizures associated with increased sensitivity to light are Possible. Some people may experience seizures when exposed to flashes of light and flashing images that appear in a video game. People who have not previously experienced such attacks may not be aware of their illness. A reasonable restriction of the game audience is recommended.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains images of scenes of violence that can have a negative impact on the psyche. Some content items may not be suitable for certain age categories. A reasonable restriction of the game audience is recommended.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WINDOWS 10, 11 (64-BIT)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 560 with 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WINDOWS 10, 11 (64-BIT)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 590 with 6GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Trapped in an infamous abandoned house, vlogger Michael must uncover the dark secrets within after his brother vanishes without a trace. Explore a terrifying, ever-changing environment where nothing is as it seems—and survival is anything but guaranteed.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Dutch
*languages with full audio support
